title: Holiday and After-Hours Multipliers on TimeBank Project Time Groups
content:
**Project band schedule.** On TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours, a group of Professional Services Projects time dated on a Saturday or Sunday has its summed minutes, raised to at least 240, multiplied by the block's holiday multiplier; a weekday group with minutes logged in the after-hours band has those after-hours minutes, rounded up to the next multiple of 60, multiplied by the block's after-hours multiplier, its other minutes keeping a multiplier of 1; a weekday group logged only in business hours keeps a multiplier of 1. The minutes so multiplied are the group's band minutes; the rest of the group's minutes drawn, if any, keep a multiplier of 1.

| Group | Band minutes | Multiplier on them |
|---|---|---|
| Saturday or Sunday | summed minutes, at least 240 | holiday multiplier of the size |
| weekday, some minutes in the after-hours band | after-hours minutes rounded up to a multiple of 60 | after-hours multiplier of the size |
| weekday, business hours only | none | 1 |

Hypothetical case on a TimeBank 40-Hour Block (holiday multiplier 2.0, after-hours multiplier 1.5) with technician lines: a weekday group of 120 business-hours minutes and 75 after-hours minutes drawn for 240 minutes has 120 band minutes at 1.5, that is 180, plus 120 minutes at 1, giving 300 weighted minutes, or 5.00 hours; a Saturday group drawn for 240 minutes has 240 band minutes at 2.0, giving 8.00 hours.
